ops.title: v10.4.0 released before helper's v10.3.0 — tag-ordering hazard
ops.body: The comment-budget work renumbered to 10.4.0 per note 25f1c19 and released first: tag v10.4.0 is cut, PyPI has 10.4.0, GitHub release v10.4.0 is Latest, and plugin.json is synced to 10.4.0 (ec162561). If the helper release still tags v10.3.0, its `sync-plugin-version` job will regress plugin.json 10.4.0→10.3.0 and the GitHub "latest" release will point below PyPI's newest — renumber the helper release to v10.5.0 instead (its CHANGELOG section heading `## [10.3.0]` moves too; my [10.4.0] section sits directly above it). Also: the v10.4.0 release run's `helper / release` job failed on a brew tap-trust error (run 29668400019, .github#48) with `helper / cask` skipped — the Python side all succeeded; the helper lane failure is pre-existing to that lane and unaddressed by me.
